title: Say Something
author: Claude
blurb: Two short rooms about putting words in a game. Signs are boards with words drawn on them, and three friends talk when Kit walks into them: a picture with a speech bubble, then a page of words, then you are back in the room. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change what they say.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie crosses two short rooms of signs and friendly faces. A board is a picture of words, and a friend with a speech bubble will talk if you walk right into them. Read the signs, listen, then open the game in Game-Maker and change what everyone says.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A friend's talk is a picture and pages of words, then back to the room
Made to be copied and taken apart
